text: Eveni Pacific is a brand of Eveni Carruthers, the trading name of I.H.Carruthers Ltd, a Samoa company founded by Irving 'Eveni' Carruthers in 1929 which describes itself as a family company led by the fourth generation of the founder's family.
short: Eveni Carruthers / Eveni Pacific is the family company I.H.Carruthers Ltd.

source.name: EveniPacific: Our Story
source.quote: Eveni Carruthers, the trading name of I.H.Carruthers Ltd with at least 91 years in business in Samoa, has stood the test of time as a family company
source.note: Company's own about page; also describes 'EveniPacific' as its Elei apparel brand.
